description: This is a C# source file defining the WorkflowManager class, which manages workflow execution, creation, triggering, resuming, and fault handling within the OrchardCore workflows module.

classes.name: WorkflowManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing workflow lifecycle, including creation, execution, resumption, triggering events, and fault handling within OrchardCore workflows.

methods.name: NewWorkflow
methods.description: Creates a new workflow instance with a specified workflow type and optional correlation ID.

methods.name: CreateWorkflowExecutionContextAsync
methods.description: Builds a workflow execution context from a workflow type and workflow instance, including activity contexts and state merging.

methods.name: CreateActivityExecutionContextAsync
methods.description: Creates an activity execution context from an activity record and properties, substituting MissingActivity if activity is not found.

methods.name: TriggerEventAsync
methods.description: Triggers workflows based on an event name, starting new workflows or resuming halted ones, with support for exclusivity and correlation.

methods.name: ResumeWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Resumes a halted workflow at a specific blocking activity with optional input.

methods.name: RestartWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Restarts a workflow from the beginning with optional input and correlation ID.

methods.name: StartWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Starts a new workflow instance and executes its start activity, with input and fault handling.

methods.name: ExecuteWorkflowAsync
methods.description: Executes a workflow starting from a specific activity, handling activity outcomes, transitions, and blocking activities.

methods.name: IncrementRecursion
methods.description: Increments recursion counters for a workflow and its type, and updates current recursion depth.

methods.name: DecrementRecursion
methods.description: Decrements recursion counters for a workflow and its type, and updates current recursion depth.

methods.name: PersistAsync
methods.description: Serializes and saves the current state of a workflow execution context.

methods.name: InvokeActivitiesAsync
methods.description: Executes a specified action on all activity contexts within a workflow.

methods.name: SerializeAsync
methods.description: Serializes a dictionary of values asynchronously.

methods.name: DeserializeAsync
methods.description: Deserializes a dictionary of values asynchronously.
